products.name: Success Ortho
products.short: Ayurvedic herbal blend for strong bones, supple joints and relief from stiffness.
description: Success Ortho is an Ayurvedic herbal formulation made with methi, green tea, nutmeg, amla, hirda, behda, hadjod, chitrak and nishottar. It is traditionally used to support bone strength, joint comfort and a healthy balance of Vata.
benefits: Supports strong bones and joints and helps raise calcium levels in the body
Helps relieve joint stiffness and swelling
Balances Vata dosha and related disorders
Helpful for numbness and tingling in the limbs
Supports comfort in the neck, back, waist, shoulder, ankle and knee
Traditionally used for spondylitis, sciatica, migraine, rheumatoid arthritis and tennis elbow
Helps ease cracking joint sounds and improves joint flexibility
Provides natural antioxidants
Helps with constipation and digestive discomfort
Supports blood circulation, nervous system function and sleep
dosage: Take 1 sachet with lukewarm water before breakfast and before dinner.
notes: While using this product, avoid curd, buttermilk, banana, brinjal, sour, spicy and oily food, and cold or refrigerated items.

products.name: Withamax
products.short: Ashwagandha-based capsule for energy, calm, sleep and hormonal balance.
description: Withamax combines Ashwagandha, Shatavari, Shilajit, Brahmi, Jatamansi, Arjuna and Guduchi. These classical herbs are traditionally used to build stamina, calm the mind and support hormonal balance in both men and women.
benefits: Helps with indigestion and constipation
Helps reduce stress and anxiety and supports sound sleep
Supports hormone balance and a regular menstrual cycle
Reduces daily fatigue and boosts energy and stamina
Supports memory, brain function and mental clarity
Supports reproductive health and male fertility
Helpful for headache and migraine
Helps keep blood pressure in a healthy range
Supports hemoglobin levels and iron absorption
dosage: Take 1 capsule in the morning and 1 capsule in the evening after breakfast or meals.

products.name: Joints Care
products.short: Glucosamine capsule that supports cartilage repair and smoother joint movement.
description: Glucosamine is a compound your body makes naturally to build cartilage, the cushion between joints. Production falls with age, which can lead to wear and joint pain. Joints Care provides glucosamine to help make up for this loss and support joint health.
benefits: Helps reduce inflammation and pain linked to osteoarthritis, knee, back, neck, hip and shoulder pain
Works on pain caused by wearing away of joint cartilage
Supports regeneration and repair of cartilage
Improves joint lubrication for smoother, easier movement
Useful for recovery and strengthening after bone fractures
Helps slow joint degeneration in older adults
Relaxes and supports the muscles around the joints
dosage: Take 1 capsule in the morning and 1 capsule in the evening after breakfast or meals.

products.name: 7 Wonders – Noni Plus
products.short: Noni-based herbal tonic with 25+ herbs, vitamins and minerals for immunity and vitality.
description: 7 Wonders – Noni Plus is a herbal health tonic built around Noni with Brahmi, Arjuna, Giloy, Ashwagandha, Amla, Aloe Vera, Triphala and many more herbs, enriched with vitamins and minerals. It is used as a daily antioxidant and immunity tonic.
benefits: Antioxidant, immunity-boosting, overall health tonic
Supports healthy blood pressure, digestion and liver function
Relieves acidity and gastric discomfort
Aids detoxification and blood purification
Supports energy, endurance and recovery
Supports memory, brain health, sleep and stress relief
Helps strengthen bones, teeth and muscles
Women's health: supports regular periods, eases menstrual cramps and PMS, and supports uterine and reproductive health
ingredients: Vitamin B Complex, C and E
Zinc, Calcium, Potassium, Magnesium, Iron, Phosphorus
dosage: Adults: 25–30 ml syrup on an empty stomach in the morning and evening, mixed with 60 ml water.
Children (5 to 10 years): 5–10 ml mixed with water.

products.name: Samarth Maha Amrut Juice
products.short: A herbal tonic of Ayurvedic herbs, berries and fruits for detox, immunity and daily energy.
description: Samarth Maha Amrut Juice is a herbal health tonic enriched with Ayurvedic medicinal herbs, fruits, berries and essential vitamins. It helps the body detoxify and supports a stronger immune system through regular use.
benefits: Helps detoxify the body and purify the system
Supports immunity and protection from common cold and cough
Supports digestion and eases gas, acidity, constipation and indigestion
Ingredients are considered supportive for blood sugar, blood pressure and cholesterol balance
Provides energy and helps reduce fatigue, weakness and body or joint pain
Supports hormonal balance and comfort during periods in women
Supports hemoglobin levels, reducing dizziness and tiredness
Antioxidants help keep skin healthy and reduce hair fall
Helps reduce stress and irritation, supports sleep, focus and brain health
Supports heart, liver and blood circulation
dosage: Mix 15 to 20 ml of juice with water and take every morning and evening on an empty stomach.

products.name: Sea Buckthorn Juice
products.short: A Himalayan sea buckthorn health drink, sugar free and rich in Omega 3, 6, 7 and 9.
description: Sea Buckthorn is a highly nutritious fruit found in the high, cold regions of the Himalayas. For thousands of years it has been used in Ayurveda to support strength, immunity and overall wellness. This juice brings it to you as a natural daily health drink.
benefits: Supports and strengthens the immune system
Gives natural energy and keeps you refreshed through the day
Helps reduce tiredness and weakness
Antioxidants help maintain healthy, glowing skin
Nutrients help keep hair strong and healthy
Supports digestion and helps meet nutritional gaps
Contains Omega 3, 6, 7 and 9, considered beneficial for overall health
Useful for daily fitness and wellness
dosage: Mix 30 ml of juice in normal or lukewarm water and take twice daily, morning and evening.

products.name: Fit 2 Fit
products.short: Ayurvedic herbal powder that supports healthy fat metabolism and weight management.
description: Weight gain is one of the most common problems today and can lead to lifestyle conditions such as diabetes, heart problems and hypertension. Fit 2 Fit is an Ayurvedic supplement made from jowar, oats, cumin, flaxseed, kachri and warming spices to support healthy fat metabolism and weight management.
benefits: Helps you stay fit and maintain a healthy body weight
Supports reduction of belly fat
Helps relieve stress and fatigue and eases gastrointestinal problems
Supports digestion and improves metabolism
Helpful for hormonal imbalance and PCOD/PCOS related concerns
Helps regulate irregular periods
Boosts immunity and overall health
Helps prevent further fat accumulation
dosage: Boil 1 sachet in 200 ml of water until it reduces to 100 ml.
Take on an empty stomach, once in the morning and once in the evening.
notes: While using this product, avoid cold drinks, deep-fried and fatty food, pizza, burgers, rice, sugar, potato, banana, maida, ice cream, chocolates, and bakery or junk food.

products.name: Alko-Vit Capsule
products.short: An alkaline food supplement made from 600+ fruits, vegetables, grains and herbs.
description: Alko-Vit is a food supplement made from over 600 different fruits, green vegetables, grains, millets, pulses, dry fruits and herbs. It is an alkaline food that helps reduce acidity in the body and maintain a healthy pH balance.
benefits: Helps maintain the body's pH balance and reduce acidity
Supports natural immunity
Provides energy and freshness through the day
Helps reduce stress and fatigue and supports sleep quality
Supports cell nutrition; keeps skin healthy and fresh
Natural source of calcium and minerals for bones and joints
Supports heart health, cholesterol and blood pressure balance
Improves digestion and metabolism; eases gas and constipation
Helps maintain a healthy weight
Supports natural detox of the liver and urinary system
Supports eye health, skin and hair
ingredients: Made from 600+ green vegetables, fruits, grains, millets and dry fruits
dosage: Take 1 capsule in the morning and 1 capsule in the evening before breakfast or meals.

products.name: Lady Care & Berry Capsule
products.short: Ayurvedic herbal supplements for menstrual and hormonal health.
description: Lady Care and Berry capsules are Ayurvedic herbal supplements formulated for women. Lady Care combines Shatavari, Ashwagandha, Ashoka, Jyeshthamadh, Manjishtha, Safed Musli and Anantmool. Berry adds Goji Berry, Daruhaldi, Barley and Green Tea.
benefits: Helps regulate irregular menstrual cycles
Eases period pain, backache, fatigue and irritability
Supportive in PCOD / PCOS concerns
Supports natural hormonal balance
Promotes reproductive health and uterine health
Supports blood purification and energy
Helps detoxify the body and improves immunity
Supports eye and skin health and healthy blood pressure
Reduces fatigue and increases vitality
ingredients: Lady Care: Shatavari, Ashwagandha, Ashoka, Jyeshthamadh (Licorice), Manjishtha, Safed Musli, Anantmool
Berry: Goji Berry, Daruhaldi, Barley, Green Tea
dosage: Take 1 capsule in the morning and 1 capsule in the evening before breakfast or meals.

products.name: Samarth Power Pack
products.short: A Rasayan of around 50 Ayurvedic herbs for strength, stamina and male reproductive health.
description: Samarth Power Pack is a herbal tonic formulated with around 50 potent Ayurvedic ingredients. This Rasayan supports immunity, stamina and male reproductive health, and helps with fatigue, sleep, emotional well-being and muscle strength.
benefits: Helps reduce body heat and builds endurance and stamina
Supports sexual desire, performance and emotional balance
Relieves mental fatigue and general weakness
Supports hormonal balance and reproductive health
Improves energy, strength and overall vitality
Supports blood circulation and detox
Supports a healthy nervous system and mental focus
ingredients: Around 50 Ayurvedic herbs in powder, chyawanprash and capsule form
dosage: Powder (men only): take with warm water at night before sleep, starting 2 days before intercourse.
Chyawanprash (men and women): from the 3rd day, take 3 g in the morning after breakfast and 5 to 10 g in the evening after dinner or before sleep, with milk, fruit juice or lukewarm water.
Capsule (men only): take 1 capsule at night with milk or lukewarm water, 1 hour before intercourse or as a tonic every 2–3 days.
notes: The capsule is for men only. Not for women.
Take the capsule only once every 2 to 3 days.
Not recommended for people with high blood pressure or heart conditions.

products.name: Samarth Stem Cells
products.short: Double stem cell formula with Swiss apple and grape stem cells plus herbs and berries.
description: Samarth Stem Cells uses a double plant stem cell formula combining Malus Domestica (Swiss apple) and Vitis Vinifera (grape) with Amla, Aloe Vera, Ashwagandha, Spirulina and Wheatgrass. These are rich in protein, iron, calcium, fibre, Vitamin C, Vitamin E, antioxidants and chlorophyll.
The body makes stem cells naturally up to about the age of 30, after which production drops. This product is designed to support the body's natural regeneration and energy.
benefits: Supports immunity and the body's natural healing power
Supports skin rejuvenation and healthy ageing
Helps protect the body from heat and temperature changes
Supports cell-level regeneration and vitality
Supports the health of organs such as the liver and kidneys
dosage: Take 1 to 2 capsules in the morning and evening after breakfast or meals.

products.name: Samarth Well Heart
products.short: A food-based herbal supplement with Arjuna, flaxseed and spices for heart health.
description: Modern diets high in oil and fat, adulterated food and sedentary living put a strain on the heart. Well Heart is a food-based supplement made with Arjuna, rock sugar, flaxseeds, bay leaf, black cumin and cinnamon to support natural heart health.
benefits: Supports heart health and cardiovascular function
Helps prevent cholesterol build-up in blood vessels
Supports arterial health and healthy circulation
Helps keep blood pressure in a healthy range
Supports immunity and resistance to disease
dosage: Take 1 sachet in the morning and 1 sachet in the evening on an empty stomach with lukewarm water.
notes: It is recommended to do a Lipid Profile Test before starting Well Heart, and to repeat it after 1 month to track improvement.
Do not stop any prescribed heart medicine without your doctor's advice.

products.name: A1 Dibocare
products.short: An Ayurvedic capsule with Gurmar, Vijaysar and Karela to support healthy blood sugar.
description: Diabetes is one of the most common health problems today. It occurs when the body cannot make or use enough insulin, so blood sugar stays high. High blood sugar slows circulation and affects immunity, wound healing, energy and organs like the eyes and kidneys. A1 Dibocare is a herbal formulation to support blood sugar management alongside a healthy lifestyle.
benefits: Helps support healthy blood sugar levels
Supports glucose metabolism and pancreatic function
Supports the body's natural insulin production
Helps reduce triglyceride levels
Eases common symptoms such as frequent urination, weakness, fatigue and dry throat
Supports the heart, kidneys, liver and nerves
dosage: If blood sugar is below 200: take 1 capsule each morning and evening before meals.
If blood sugar is above 200: take 2 capsules each morning and evening before meals.
notes: Do not stop or change prescribed diabetes medicines without your doctor's advice. Monitor your blood sugar regularly.

products.name: Kidney Stone Kit
products.short: Dezotone capsules and Vedatri Churna, an Ayurvedic kit for kidney and bladder stone care.
description: Poor diet and too little water can lead to kidney stones, which usually form from excess calcium oxalate or other mineral crystals. Symptoms can include fever, vomiting, nausea, severe lower abdomen or back pain, burning during urination or blood in urine. The Kidney Stone Kit pairs Dezotone capsules with Vedatri Churna, made from Pashanbhed, Gokhru, Punarnava and other traditional herbs.
benefits: Traditionally used to help break down and pass small kidney and bladder stones
Helps reduce burning sensation in the urinary tract
Helps ease stone-related discomfort
Herbal Ayurvedic formulation
dosage: Capsules: take 2 capsules in the morning and 2 capsules in the evening before meals.
Churna: boil 1 teaspoon of powder in 200 ml water until it reduces to 100 ml. Take after meals, morning and evening.
notes: Drink plenty of water. If pain, fever or blood in urine continues, see a doctor without delay.

products.name: Piles Care
products.short: Panchamsam Churna and Pitone capsules, a herbal kit for piles comfort.
description: Piles affect both men and women and are mainly linked to irregular eating habits and constipation. Panchamsam Churna is an Ayurvedic formulation of traditional herbs that strengthens digestion, eases constipation, purifies blood and helps reduce swelling and pain. It is paired with Pitone capsules in this kit.
benefits: 100% herbal formulation
Relieves constipation
Helps reduce pain and swelling
Helps relieve itching and burning sensation
Supports healing of rectal wounds and reduces bleeding
dosage: Capsules: take 2 capsules in the morning and 2 capsules in the evening before meals.
Churna: take 1 teaspoon of powder with lukewarm or normal water after meals, morning and evening.
notes: If bleeding is heavy or persistent, consult a doctor.

products.name: Ashwarin Plus
products.short: Ashwagandha, Shilajit and Safed Musli capsule for stamina, hormone balance and energy.
description: Ashwarin Plus is an Ayurvedic supplement made with Ashwagandha, Talimakhana, Kaunch Beej, Safed Musli, Shilajit and Kantakari, along with traditional bhasma. It supports sexual health, hormonal balance and mental and physical energy in both men and women.
benefits: Supports testosterone levels, sperm count and motility in men
Boosts energy and stamina and helps overcome weakness and fatigue
Supports hormonal balance and reproductive health in women
Helps reduce stress, anxiety and fatigue
Supports immunity, circulation and muscle strength
Supports hemoglobin and healthy cholesterol
Supportive in PCOD-related concerns
dosage: Take 2 capsules in the morning and 2 capsules in the evening after meals.

products.name: Health Drink (Stevia)
products.short: Natural stevia drops, a healthy sugar substitute for daily use.
description: Stevia is a natural sweetener extracted from the Stevia plant and is widely used as a sugar substitute. Research points to antioxidant, antimicrobial and antifungal properties. This Health Drink offers stevia as a simple daily wellness supplement and a sugar-free option for people watching their sugar intake.
benefits: Helps support healthy blood sugar levels
Helps the body absorb essential nutrients and minerals
Supports energy levels
Supports healthy weight management
Supports physical and mental strength
Strengthens immunity and resistance
dosage: Add 10 drops to 250 ml water and take twice daily before meals.

products.name: Samarth Soil Power
products.short: Humic and fulvic acid soil supplement for healthier soil and stronger crops.
description: In modern farming, keeping the soil fertile is key to quality and yield. Soil Power is an agricultural supplement formulated with Humic Acid, Fulvic Acid and Potassium to improve soil health and support strong, healthy crop growth.
benefits: Improves soil fertility and makes soil looser, softer and more productive
Humic and Fulvic Acid make soil nutrients easier for plants to absorb
Strengthens root development and nutrient uptake
Keeps leaves greener, healthier and more vibrant
Supports flowering and fruit setting for better yield
Improves size, colour, shine and quality of crops and fruit
Helps crops tolerate heat, drought and changing weather
Suitable for vegetables, fruit crops, cereals, sugarcane and many other crops
dosage: Foliar spray: mix 1 to 2 g of Soil Power per litre of water.
Drip irrigation or soil application: use 1 to 2 kg per acre mixed with water.
Timing: apply every 15 to 20 days during the crop growth stage for better results.

products.name: Samarth Sakhi Sanitary Pads
products.short: Soft cottony sanitary pads with wings, super absorption and odour control.
description: Samarth Sakhi Sanitary Pads are designed for women's hygiene, comfort and confidence during menstruation. A soft cottony surface, high absorbency, leakage protection, secure wings and Anion Chip Technology help you stay comfortable and active through the day. Tagline: Wings of Confidence for Every Woman.
benefits: Soft cottony cover for a gentle, comfortable feel
Super absorption for effective fluid absorption
Leakage protection with a secure absorbent structure
Secure-grip wings keep the pad in place
Odour control design for lasting freshness
Lightweight and comfortable for everyday use
Anion Chip Technology for added hygiene support
290 mm size for better coverage
notes: Change pads regularly as advised for good menstrual hygiene.
